title: FrontierMath Ramsey Hypergraphs
abstract: Formalizes lower bounds for the Brian-Larson hypergraph extremal function H(n), including a uniform 26/25 improvement over the recursive benchmark k_n for n ≥ 15 and a Lubell-frame asymptotic lower bound.

informal.HypergraphLowerBound.thm_main_H_lower_bo: Proves H(n) ≥ 26 * k(n) / 25 for every n ≥ 15.
informal.HypergraphLowerBound.uniform_26_25: Proves the uniform recursive construction bound A(n) ≥ 26 * k(n) / 25 for every n ≥ 15.
informal.HypergraphLowerBound.frame_recurrence: The substitution-frame recurrence that combines block witnesses and a valid support frame into a larger witness.
informal.HypergraphLowerBound.lubell_is_frame: Proves that the Lubell support family forms a valid frame for every arity t ≥ 2.
informal.HypergraphLowerBound.fixed_t_bound: Derives a fixed-t lower bound for the exact witness supremum from Lubell frames.
informal.HypergraphLowerBound.asymptotic_lower_bo: Proves the asymptotic lower bound liminf H(n) / k(n) ≥ 2 * log 2.
informal.HypergraphLowerBound.thm_asymptotic: States the asymptotic consequence in terms of H(n) divided by n log n.
